results.title: First visit loads the shell with no errors
results.expected: Exercise tab, picker and both start buttons; no console or page errors
results.actual: shell ready; DCL 165 ms, load 167 ms

results.title: [sim] Complete session saves once and shows triage for that session
results.expected: +1 session row; outcome card lists agent tool calls; run log has a run for that session id
results.actual: session 206 saved once (3 reps, source simulation); 3 tool calls recorded for it; 1 POST

results.title: [stub] Save fails with 500, then retry
results.expected: error shown, reps kept, a retry control saves exactly one row

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Stop releases the camera and the loop
results.expected: all tracks ended; inference rAF stops

results.title: [synthetic-cam] Camera disconnects mid-session
results.expected: the app says the camera stopped, stops the loop, and offers a way forward
results.actual: "The camera stopped (unplugged, turned off, or taken by another app). Start it ag"; loop stopped

results.title: [synthetic-cam]+[sim] What leaves the browser during camera use and a saved session
results.expected: only same-origin app API and static assets; the session POST carries scored numbers only
results.actual: same-origin only; 4 API routes; session POST 455 bytes with fields patient_id, exercise_key, side, started_at, ended_at, pain_score, source, reps, client_ref; no storage, no websockets

results.title: No horizontal scrolling across tabs and viewports
results.expected: scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth on every tab at 360, 390, 768, 1366, 1920 and a 200% zoom proxy (683 px)

results.title: Lost tracking is communicated and the reading is not shown as live
results.expected: status says tracking is lost and the angle is visibly marked as not live
results.actual: "Step into frame to calibrate"; gauge dimmed (rgb(138, 150, 179))
